newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SBC Warburg downgrades UK brewers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SBC Warburg downgrades UK brewers.

text.p: The UK brewing sector was cut to "neutral" from "overweight" at SBC Warburg, market sources said on Monday.
Analysts at the brokerage declined comment on reasons for the change.
In the sector, Bass Plc shares were down 6-1/2p at 802-1/2, Scottish & Newcastle Plc was down 6p at 669 and Whitbread Plc was down 6-1/2p at 763-1/2.
Separately a spokesman for Bass said that talk that it had abandoned its planned acquisiton of Carlsberg-Tetley was just speculation.

The Monopolies and Mergers Commission handed over its findings on the proposed acquisiton to trade secretary Ian Lang today and some analysts believe its conditions are too onerous to make the deal worthwhile.
The acquisition would be the latest in a series of deals reshaping the UK brewing industry.
